title: Analyzer QC & Configuration MVP — UAT
intro: Review the lab-facing analyzer setup workflow. Mark each required step Pass or Fail and explain anything confusing or incorrect.

steps.do: Find a shipped analyzer profile and inspect its protocol, mapping count, and QC readiness.
steps.expect: The profile is searchable and its setup readiness is understandable without developer-only fields.

steps.do: Start setup from that profile and create an analyzer in the inline workflow.
steps.expect: The selected profile carries into setup, required fields are clear, and the saved analyzer appears in the analyzer list.

steps.do: Review and confirm the profile-applied test mappings and QC mappings.
steps.expect: Every deterministic match is visible, exceptions are explicit, and the completed review records who confirmed it and when.

steps.do: Enter connection settings and run Test connection.
steps.expect: A visible success or failure result explains whether the configured analyzer endpoint can be reached.

steps.do: Resolve a pending qualitative analyzer value using a result option from its mapped OpenELIS test.
steps.expect: Only valid catalog options are offered, the resolution remains after reload, and the pending item disappears.

steps.do: Add or select an active analyzer QC rule and control lot.
steps.expect: Both are visible from the analyzer workflow and QC readiness updates without a hidden second setup path.

steps.do: Observe readiness before and after mapping verification and QC setup are complete.
steps.expect: The analyzer cannot become Active while required setup is incomplete and clearly reports Ready when all blockers are resolved.

steps.do: Review the completed analyzer configuration as a laboratory administrator.
steps.expect: The profile, mappings, connection, and QC state form one coherent lab-facing workflow without raw plugin configuration or duplicate editors.
